text: BAM share rose 0.01 percentage points over 23 hours and 1.51 percentage points over 7 days, to 34.3%. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 22.6% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 63 top-node leadership changes in this window are best read as whale-driven routing, not a structural rollover; only the fra rollover on 2026-06-24 has been validated.
